# Nell Harcourt

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixteen and a half  <sub>[v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female
- **Origin:** Harborough, Nova Scotia
- **Role:** Student, aspiring teacher  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>
- **Titles:** Nell of Grey Shutters  <sub>[v1 c10 P49](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0049)</sub>; Lady Lucinda Fitzgerald
- **Nicknames:** Nelle; Lucinda; Carrots; Nell-girl

## Appearance

Nell is a tall, upright, and scrawny youth with freckles and bright gray eyes. She is known for her naturally red hair, which she once disastrously dyed green with dye bought from an itinerant German merchant. She takes great interest in stylish clothing and wears various dresses crafted by Thirza or gifted by community members.

_Sources: [v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c27 P15](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0015), [v1 c27 P16](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0016), [v1 c27 P28](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0028)_

## Personality

Nell is a highly imaginative, sensitive, and high-spirited girl with a flair for the dramatic and a deep appreciation for nature. She frequently engages in creative play and imaginative daydreams, picturing herself in grand scenarios or as forces of nature. Although she can be quick-tempered, passionate, and prone to misadventures, she is deeply reflective, competitive, and determined to do good. She harbors intense loyalty to those she loves and displays remarkable resilience when facing hardship.

_Sources: [v1 c10 P46](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0046), [v1 c10 P52](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0052), [v1 c12 P25](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0025), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c27 P11](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0011), [v1 c27 P22](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0022)_

- Imaginative and dramatic  <sub>[v1 c10 P52](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0052)</sub>

- Fear of public disgrace  <sub>[v1 c27 P11](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0011)</sub>

- Public recitations and dramatic performance  <sub>[v1 c27 P11](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0011)</sub>
- Essay writing and composition  <sub>[v1 c27 P11](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0011)</sub>
- Singing in choirs  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>

## Goals

- To qualify as a teacher through higher education
- To remain permanently at Grey Shutters  <sub>[v1 c10 P49](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0049)</sub>
- To achieve personal and spiritual goodness  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c27 P22](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0022)</sub>

## History

After living in an asylum in Marden, Nell was brought to Grey Shutters to reside with Thirza Abernethy and Obed Abernethy. Though initially expected to be sent away because the household wanted a boy, she won over her guardians and came to view Grey Shutters as her true home. She established a firm friendship with Isolde Pembroke, taking a solemn vow of lifelong companionship in the Pembroke garden. She attended Brierley School under the instruction of Miss Agnes Thorne, excelling academically while engaging in a fierce rivalry with classmate Hugh Carrow. Her time in Brierley was marked by energetic misadventures, including accidentally dying her red hair green after purchasing a dye from a travelling German merchant. Over time, she matured into an outstanding scholar, preparing diligently for entrance exams and pursuing a career in teaching while offering deep comfort and companionship to her guardians.

_Sources: [v1 c10 P49](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0049), [v1 c12 P25](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0025), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c27 P16](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0016), [v1 c27 P20](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0020), [v1 c27 P28](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0028)_

## Background by volume

- Orphaned in childhood after the deaths of her parents, Edmund and Bertha Harcourt
- Lived in various foster homes, including with Mrs. Thomas and Mrs. Rudge, and spent four months in an asylum at Marden  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>
- Brought to Grey Shutters by mistake due to a miscommunicated message regarding an orphan boy
